source: express-fileupload@1.5.2 lib/index.js default option object + README, frozen at the base commit
description: Frozen baseline of the public contract the migration must preserve. ``preserved_express_checks`` must hold for *every* legitimate candidate (migrated or not) and is what the hard gate enforces; ``target_koa_checks`` describe the Koa surface the completion verifier measures. ``gated_koa_checks`` lists the subset of target checks that are observable public defaults and therefore also gate a candidate that actually exercises the Koa path. The gate loads this file instead of an inline tuple so the contract cannot silently drift with the implementation.

option_defaults.responseOnLimit: File size limit has been reached

option_defaults_check_map_note: Every express_surface.option_defaults key is mapped to the probe check that observes it. Keys whose check id is listed in preserved_express_checks gate the candidate; the rest are recorded by the target-Koa registry. limitHandler is observed through the default size-limit behaviour (no custom handler, no abort). The hard gate refuses to score when a key has no mapping or a mapping names an unregistered check (QC items 53/56).
